problem: does the aligned-factor null law, in coordinates (u,v,w)=(beta_0^2, beta_1^2, beta_0*beta_1), vary monotonically in each coordinate separately over the feasible set w^2 <= uv?

design.output: fwer at fixed c=2.20 (one evaluator call per point; sign of dFWER/dx at fixed c equals sign of dc*/dx since dFWER/dc < 0 everywhere, so the verdict transfers to the critical constant used by Unit 2B)
design.lam_rationale: endpoints plus geometric center of w2_cert.py's declared box lgrid = log_grid(0.04, 25.0, 7); sqrt(0.04*25.0)=1.0.  The kill test therefore covers 2B's whole lambda axis at its edges and middle.
design.box_source: w2_cert.py bgrid = linspace(-1.5, 1.5, 5) for both loadings -> u,v in [0, 2.25], w in [-2.25, 2.25]
design.n_source: w2_cert.py n = [36.0, 36.0]; same n as every w2_factor falsifier and every Unit 5 ladder

grid.margin_handling: a feasible point is BOUNDARY LAYER iff sqrt(u*v)-|w| <= dw  OR  u == 0  OR  v == 0 (within one w-step of the cone surface, or on the cone's degenerate faces); otherwise STRICTLY INSIDE.  Both regions are evaluated; verdicts are reported per region and combined.  A difference is layer if EITHER endpoint is layer.
grid.axis_choice: 61 not 60 so that w = 0 and the box faces land exactly on nodes (the specification says 'e.g. 60^3'); every coordinate face of the declared box is therefore sampled.

primary.name: GRID
primary.justification: w2_factor.py's reference rule and the rule the 4,000,000-draw validation (worst |z| 1.58) was measured against; deposit deposits/w2_factor.json grid field is exactly this.

h12.name: GRID+
h12.justification: H-12 requires the monotonicity verdict to survive a refinement change: outer panels 3 -> 4 (normal and chi-square rules), inner nodes unchanged.  Different discretisation at ~2.4x the per-eval cost, feasible over the full grid.

fd.scheme: adjacent forward differences along each coordinate ((i,i+1), (j,j+1), (k,k+1)) over pairs where both endpoints are feasible; every feasible point evaluated exactly once; span recorded per difference (du, du, dw respectively)
fd.tol_justification: max of two declared noise floors, both measured/derived BEFORE any grid run: (1) MC validation conversion as specified: 2 x 1.58 x sqrt(0.25/4000000) = 7.9e-04 (|z| <= 1.58 over 4,000,000 draws, worst case of sqrt(p(1-p)/N) over the rate range); (2) quadrature: 2 x 1.9894e-04 = 3.98e-04, the measured worst GRID-vs-FINE gap at the noisiest declared cell (beta=(1.5,-1.5), lam=0.04).  Floor = 7.9e-04, declared 1e-03.  |diff| <= tol_fd is INDETERMINATE: counted and reported, never assigned a sign.
fd.why_not_FAST: measured FAST-vs-GRID gap reaches 6.2556e-03 at (1.5,-1.5) lam=0.25 (opposite-sign corner), which would force tol_fd >= 1.3e-02 and blank out exactly the region Table 33's U-shape lives in; FAST was rejected as a kill-test level on this measurement.

verdict_rules.per_difference: confident + if diff > tol_fd, confident - if diff < -tol_fd, else INDETERMINATE
verdict_rules.direction: majority sign of confident differences (npos vs nneg); a tie with both signs present is non-monotone
verdict_rules.monotone: no confident minority-sign differences AND confident fraction (npos+nneg)/ntotal >= 0.50 -> monotone(direction)
verdict_rules.inconclusive: no confident minority-sign differences but confident fraction < 0.50 -> INCONCLUSIVE (noise dominates; cannot certify)
verdict_rules.monotone_with_exceptions: minority-sign differences exist, exactly ONE connected component under 26-neighbour adjacency of their lower grid endpoints, and the component's bounding box extent is <= 20% of 61 in EACH of the three axes -> monotone-with-exceptions (region reported)
verdict_rules.non_monotone: otherwise (multiple components, or bbox wider than 20% on any axis, or a confident sign tie)
verdict_rules.regions: interior, layer, and combined are each verdicted per coordinate
verdict_rules.per_ratio: verdict per lambda, per coordinate, per region
verdict_rules.combined: worst class across the three lambda values, class order: monotone < monotone-with-exceptions < inconclusive < non-monotone for reporting; D0-2 shape uses: all monotone -> (i); all in {monotone, exceptions} with >=1 exceptions -> (ii); any non-monotone -> (iii); inconclusive present without non-monotone -> UNDECIDED (extra declared outcome: the kill test does not decide)
verdict_rules.h12_survival: for every (lambda, coordinate, region): class and (if monotone) direction at the primary level must EQUAL the class/direction at the H-12 level, else the verdict does not survive the refinement change (H-12 kill)

AN1_wrapper_equals_native.claim: the (u,v,w) wrapper reproduces w2_factor.AlignedFactor.fwer exactly at boundary and degenerate-face cells (native code is the 4,000,000-draw-validated evaluator, so equality inherits that validation)

AN2_sign_invariance.claim: m depends on (beta_0-beta_1) only through d^2 = u+v-2w: flipping the sign of d must leave the integral unchanged (symmetric z-f rule).  This is what makes interior points (w^2 < uv) well defined.

cells.deposit_path: w5_limits.json f3_ladders A1 rho ladder beta=(1,1) rho=1
w5_limits.json f3_ladders A1 rho ladder beta=(0,0) rho=1

AN3_deposit_values.tol_grid_justification: measured worst GRID-vs-FINE on these two cells: 5.5e-07 and 1.83e-06; declared 1e-05 (>=5x margin)
AN3_deposit_values.claim: same-parameter values against Unit 5's ladder deposit (P-1: tokens read from the deposit at run time)

AN3b_deposit_direction.claim: Unit 5's A2 equal-loading ladder is strictly decreasing (deposit tokens 1.456e-03 at t=1 > 6.29e-06 at t=2 > 2.19e-11 at t=4); at the run level f(1,1,1) must exceed f(4,4,4) and f(16,16,16) by an order relation (measured quadrature noise 2x6.2e-04 FAST-scale cannot flip a 1.45e-03 gap)
AN3b_deposit_direction.note: cells outside the kill box (law-level anchor); within Unit 5's stated validity range (A2 ladder trusted through t=128)

AN5_verdict_machinery.claim: the verdict function is tested on synthetic difference sets with known classes before it is allowed to read real diffs
cases: single small negative blob inside 20% bbox -> monotone-with-exceptions
negative diffs in two separated components -> non-monotone
equal confident counts both signs -> non-monotone

measurement_probe_before_declaration.note: all tolerances above were frozen from these measurements before any kill-test grid point was evaluated

runtime.chain: primary -> H-12 -> verdict, single background chain, resumable from per-level JSONL row files

scope_notes: verdict is at fixed c=2.20 (the specification says 'the evaluator output'; c-dependence of monotonicity is outside this test and recorded as a caveat for Unit 2B's ASM-2)
monotonicity in lambda is NOT tested; lambda is a separate axis of 2B's box
K=1 (coordinates are per-candidate; K>1 coupling is outside this test)
L-cone-1 (cone extreme-point lemma) is NOT needed to run the grid; it is flagged PROVEN/planned-tier in the unit output after the verdict
